name: St. Charles Borromeo
title: Apostle of the Council of Trent
quotes: We ought to walk in front, and our spiritual subjects will follow us more easily.
Ecce venio.

name: St. Alexander of Alexandria
quotes: Athanasius, you think you can escape, but you will not.

name: St. Agnes of Assisi
quotes: Believe me, I shall never be separated from you, nor from the poverty of Christ.

name: St. Cajetan
quotes: I see my Savior carrying the cross, and I will not permit myself to die on a bed of down.
Do not be afraid; our Father will take care of us.

name: St. Maximus the Confessor
title: The Theologian
quotes: The Roman see... has received universal and supreme dominion, authority and power of binding and loosing over all the holy Churches of God which are in the whole world.
Even the weakest waxes mighty and the meek becomes a warrior, and by comforting his soul with the Divine Word, is hardened against the greatest attack.
The union of man with God is achieved by the practice of perfection and contemplation.

name: St. Methodius of Olympus
quotes: The world was made for the sake of man, and man was made for the sake of God.
The body is the instrument of the soul, and in the resurrection, the instrument shall be restored to its player.

name: St. Mechtilde
title: Christ's Nightingale
quotes: All this has been committed to writing by my will and inspiration; and, therefore you have no cause to be troubled about it.

name: St. Adalbert
title: Apostle of Prussia
quotes: Lord, receive my spirit; and you, O Lord, forgive them.

name: St. Patrick
title: Apostle of Ireland
quotes: I bind to myself today the strong virtue of the Invocation of the Trinity.
Christ with me, Christ before me, Christ behind me, Christ within me.
The love of God and His fear increased in me more and more, and the faith grew in me, and the spirit was roused.

name: St. Agatha
title: The Virgin Martyr of Catania
quotes: Jesus Christ, Lord of all things! You see my heart, You know my desires. Possess all that I am—You alone.
Lord, my Creator, You have protected me since I was in the cradle. You have taken me from the love of the world and given me patience to suffer.

name: St. Ælred
title: The English Bernard
quotes: It is no small consolation in this life to have someone to whom you can be united in the bond of love and the embrace of a holy friendship.
No medicine is more valuable, none more efficacious, none more suited to our wounds in all the things of this world than a friend.

name: St. Macrina the Younger
title: The Teacher
quotes: The soul is an essence created, living, rational, transmitting from itself to an organized and sentient body the power of living.
Thou, O Lord, hast freed us from the fear of death.

name: St. Ailbe
title: Apostle of Munster
quotes: Ailbe loved hospitality. The devotion was not untruthful. Never entered a body of clay one that was better as to food and raiment.

name: St. Maelruan
title: Abbot of Tallaght
quotes: It is not for the sake of the food that we fast, but for the sake of the power that is in the fasting.

name: St. Thomas Garnet
title: Protomartyr of St. Omer
quotes: I am the happiest man this day alive.

name: St. Albert of Louvain
title: Defender of Ecclesiastical Liberty
quotes: I am ready to die for the Church of God.

name: St. Albertus Magnus
title: The Universal Doctor
quotes: Experiment is the only safe guide in such investigations.
The aim of natural science is not simply to accept the statements of others, but to investigate the causes that are at work in nature.
Whoever believes that Aristotle was a god, must also believe that he never erred. But if one believe that Aristotle was a man, then doubtless he was liable to error just as we are.

name: St. Pammachius
quotes: Other husbands scatter on the graves of their wives violets, roses, and lilies; our Pammachius waters the holy ashes and bones of Paulina with the balsam of almsgiving.

name: St. Olaf Haraldson
quotes: God help me

name: St. Francis Xavier
title: Apostle of the Indies
quotes: Yet it is not that the Cross is wanting, but that those who should bear it are wanting.
If you will not give me any other way, I will swim to China.
Give me souls, take away the rest.

name: St. Malachy
title: Primate of Ireland
quotes: In your hands, O Lord, I commend my spirit.

name: St. Aloysius Gonzaga
title: Patron of Youth
quotes: I am a piece of twisted iron; I entered religion to be made straight.
It is better to be a child of God than king of the whole world.
There is no more certain way to find God than through Mary.

name: St. Francis de Sales
title: Doctor of Charity
quotes: God's will be done! Jesus, my God and my all!
A spoonful of honey attracts more flies than a barrel of vinegar.
Be who you are and be that well, so as to do honor to the Master Craftsman whose work you are.

name: St. Ambrose
title: Doctor of Virgins
quotes: The Church belongs to God, therefore it ought not to be assigned to Caesar.
When I am at Rome, I fast on a Saturday; when I am at Milan, I do not. Follow the custom of the church where you are.
No one heals himself by wounding another.

name: St. Ambrose of Camaldoli
quotes: Do not rend asunder Christ's seamless robe.

name: St. Flavian
quotes: I appeal to the throne of the Apostolic See of Peter.

name: St. Anne Line
quotes: I am sentenced to die for harbouring a Catholic priest, and so far I am from repenting for having so done, that I wish, with all my soul, that where I have entertained one, I could have entertained a thousand.

name: St. Angela Merici
title: Foundress of the Ursulines
quotes: Do now what you will wish to have done when your last hour comes.
Disorder in society is the result of disorder in the family.

name: St. Odilo
title: Archangel of the Monks
quotes: I would rather be judged for being too merciful than for being too severe.

name: St. Arsenius
title: The Great
quotes: Arsenius, flee the company of men, and thou shalt be saved.
I have often repented of having spoken, but never of having remained silent.

name: St. Catherine of Bologna
quotes: The servant of Christ must never be without the seven spiritual weapons.
I leave this book to you with the greatest love, and I beg you to read it with great care.

name: St. Andrew Avellino
quotes: The mouth that belieth killeth the soul.

name: St. Antonio Maria Zaccaria
title: Apostle of the Forty Hours
quotes: Run like madmen, not only toward God but also toward your neighbors.
I charge you: remain in the love of God.

name: St. Melania the Younger
quotes: I have been a pilgrim in the world, and I am now going to my true home.

name: St. Maximus of Turin
quotes: He who sows in the winter of this life will reap in the summer of the next.

The man who provides for his own life in this world, but does not provide for the life of the world to come, is like a man who builds a house for the day, but leaves himself without a roof for the night.

name: St. Afra
quotes: I am a sinner, but I am a Christian.
The body which hath sinned shall suffer; but the soul shall not be defiled.

name: St. Augustine of Canterbury
title: Apostle of the English
quotes: We beseech thee, O Lord, in the fulness of thy pity that Thine anger and Thy holy wrath be turned away from this city and from Thy holy house, because we have sinned: Alleluia!
If ye will not have peace with the brethren, ye shall have war from your enemies; and if ye will not preach the way of life to the English, ye shall suffer the punishment of death at their hands.

name: St. Augustine of Hippo
title: Doctor of Grace
quotes: Late have I loved Thee, O Beauty ever ancient, ever new, late have I loved Thee!
Thou hast made us for Thyself, O Lord, and our heart is restless until it rests in Thee.
Love, and do what thou wilt.

name: St. John Chrysostom
quotes: Glory be to God for all things.
The waters have risen and the severe storm is upon us, but we do not fear being drowned, for we stand upon a rock.

name: St. Baithen
title: Baithen the Great
quotes: Deus in adjutorium meum intende.

name: St. Baithen of Iona
title: Baithen Mor
quotes: Deus in adjutorium meum intende

name: St. Bartholomew
quotes: Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
Can anything of good come from Nazareth?

name: St. Basil the Great
title: Father of Eastern Monasticism
quotes: The bread which you do not use is the bread of the hungry; the garment hanging in your wardrobe is the garment of him who is naked.
A tree is known by its fruit; a man by his deeds.
The Holy Spirit is the source of all holiness.

name: St. Boniface
title: Apostle of Germany
quotes: In her voyage across the ocean of this world, the Church is like a great ship being pounded by the waves of life's different stresses. Our duty is not to abandon ship but to keep her on her course.
Let us stand fast in what is right, and prepare our souls for trial.

name: St. Optatus
title: Bishop of Milevis
quotes: Sacramenta per se esse sancta, non per homines.
What is an altar but the seat of the Body and Blood of Christ?
In the city of Rome upon Peter first the chair of the bishop was conferred, in which sat the head of all the Apostles.

name: St. John of the Cross
title: The Mystical Doctor
quotes: Where there is no love, put love, and you will find love.
To suffer and to be despised.
In the evening of life, we will be judged on love alone.

name: St. Benedict of Nursia
title: Father of Western Monasticism
quotes: Idleness is the enemy of the soul.
The first degree of humility is obedience without delay.
Let them prefer nothing whatever to Christ.

name: St. Benedict Joseph Labre
title: The Beggar of Perpetual Adoration
quotes: Our heart is small, but God is very big. May our heart love Him!
To love God, we must have three hearts in one: a heart of fire for God, a heart of flesh for our neighbor, and a heart of bronze for ourselves.

name: St. Martin of Tours
title: Apostle of Gaul
quotes: Lord, if Thy people still need me, I do not draw back from labor. Thy will be done.
I am a soldier of Christ; it is not lawful for me to fight.

name: St. Alban
title: Protomartyr of Britain
quotes: I worship and adore the true and living God who created all things.

name: St. Caesarius of Arles
title: The Great Legislator
quotes: The man who does not hear the Word of God with desire, even though he does no evil, is not far from death.
As a man who seeks a physician for the body is concerned, so should a man seek a physician for his soul.

name: St. Bercharius
quotes: I forgive you for the love of Christ; go to Rome and do penance.

name: St. Mary Magdalen
title: Apostle to the Apostles
quotes: Rabboni!
They have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

name: St. John Capistran
title: The Soldier Priest
quotes: Victory, Jesus, Victory!

name: St. Bernardine of Siena
title: The Apostle of Italy
quotes: All Italy is already my diocese.
Father, I have manifested Thy Name to men... I come to Thee.

name: St. Casimir
title: Prince of Poland
quotes: Omni die dic Mariae mea laudes anima.

name: St. John Joseph of the Cross
St. Toribio Alfonso Mogrovejo
title: Apostle of Peru
quotes: Time is not our own, and we must give a strict account of it.

name: St. Bridget of Sweden
title: Prophetess of the North
quotes: There is no sinner in the world, however much at enmity with God, who cannot return to Him and recover His grace, if he has recourse to Mary and asks her assistance.
The world would have peace if only the men of the world would follow the Gospel.

name: St. Mary of Egypt
title: The Penitent of the Desert
quotes: Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word in peace, because my eyes have seen thy salvation.

name: St. Nilus
title: The Elder
quotes: Prayer is the sprout of gentleness and the absence of anger.
If you want to pray properly, do not let yourself be saddened, otherwise you run in vain.

name: St. Pascal Baylon
title: Seraph of the Eucharist
quotes: Our love for the Blessed Sacrament must be as a burning fire.

name: St. Caedmon
title: The Father of English Sacred Poetry
quotes: Now we must praise the Guardian of the Kingdom of Heaven, the power of the Creator and His counsel, the deeds of the Father of glory.

name: St. Olympias
title: The Deaconess
quotes: Had God intended me to remain a wife, He would not have taken Nebridius from me.

name: St. Aldhelm
quotes: Virginity is a gold coin, marriage a silver one.

name: St. Camillus de Lellis
title: Apostle of the Sick
quotes: More heart in those hands!
The poor and the sick are the heart of God; in serving them, we serve Jesus Christ.

name: St. Peter of Alexandria
title: The Seal of the Martyrs
quotes: Arius has rent the garment of Christ, which is the Church.

name: St. Pachomius
title: Father of Cenobitic Monasticism
quotes: To be a Christian is to be a servant of all.
The rule of the heart must be guarded as strictly as the rule of the cell.

name: St. Papias
title: Apostolic Father
quotes: I considered that I should not get so much advantage from matter in books as from the voice which yet lives and remains.

name: St. Catherine de' Ricci
quotes: Think of the Passion of Christ, for it is the source of all our good.
May the Passion of our Lord Jesus Christ be ever in our hearts.

name: St. Cecilia
title: Patroness of Church Music
quotes: While the musicians played at her nuptials she sang in her heart to God only.

name: St. Chromatius
quotes: The Lord says: You are the salt of the earth. By the earth, the Lord means the human race, which the salt of the divine word must season.

name: St. Francis de Geronimo
title: Apostle of Naples
quotes: He is a lamb when he talks, but a lion when he preaches.

name: St. Peter Chrysologus
title: The Golden Worded
quotes: He who wants to play with the devil cannot rejoice with Christ.
The blessed Peter, who lives and presides in his own see, gives the truth of faith to those who seek it.

name: St. Columba
title: Apostle of the Picts
quotes: Alone with none but Thee, my God, I journey on my way.
He who is not a friend to the friend of God shall not be a friend to God.

name: St. Paschasius
title: Father of the Poor
quotes: The acts and miracles of the saint could not be described better than has already been done.

name: St. Cuthbert
title: Wonder-worker of England
quotes: Be faithful to Catholic unity and the traditions of the Fathers.

name: St. Eithne
title: Of the Golden Hair
quotes: It were better for you to confess your faith in our true God than ask about our race.

name: St. Paul
title: Apostle of the Gentiles
quotes: For to me, to live is Christ: and to die is gain.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.
I live, now not I; but Christ liveth in me.

name: St. Frances of Rome
title: The Mystic of Rome
quotes: A married woman must, when called upon, quit her devotions to God at the altar to find Him in her household affairs.

name: St. Conan
title: Bishop of the Isle of Man

name: St. Columbanus
title: Apostle of Burgundy
quotes: We are bound to the Chair of Peter, and although Rome is great and renowned, through that Chair alone is she looked on as great and illustrious among us.
Love is not orderly; it is this which has made it confused.
I came as a poor stranger into these parts for the cause of Christ, Our Saviour.

name: St. Gerald
title: Apostle of the Saxons in Ireland

name: St. Fructuosus of Tarragona
quotes: I am a Christian and a bishop.

name: St. Francis Borgia
title: The Second Founder of the Society of Jesus

name: St. Paschasius Radbertus
quotes: The Body of Christ in the Eucharist is no other flesh than that which was born of Mary, suffered on the cross, and rose from the grave.

name: St. Cyprian of Carthage
quotes: Outside the Church there is no salvation.
A good will which knows God cannot be altered.

name: St. Denis
title: Apostle of France
quotes: Blessed Denis, Bishop of the Parisii, after being afflicted with various punishments for the name of Christ, ended his present life by the impending sword.

name: St. Dionysius
quotes: For this has been your custom from the beginning, to do good to all the brethren in many ways, and to send alms to many Churches in different cities.
Today we have kept the holy Lord's day, on which we have read your letter, which we shall ever possess to read and to be admonished.
You also by this instruction have mingled together the Romans and Corinthians who are the planting of Peter and Paul.

name: St. Dunstan
title: Restorer of Monasticism
quotes: He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: He hath given food to them that fear Him.

name: St. Germanus I
quotes: If we represent the human form of the Word, it is to show that He really became man and did not just appear so.
I am ready to die for the traditions of the Fathers and for the honor of the images of my Savior.

name: St. Thomas of Villanova
title: The Almsgiver
quotes: In manus tuas, Domine, commendo spiritum meum.
If you want God to hear your prayers, hear the voice of the poor.

name: St. John Fisher
quotes: I am ready to die on behalf of the indissolubility of marriage.

name: St. John Damascene
title: The Golden Stream
quotes: I do not adore matter; I adore the Creator of matter who became matter for my sake.
The beauty of the images moves me to contemplation, as a meadow delights the eyes and subtly infuses the soul with the glory of God.

name: St. Anastasius Sinaita
title: The New Moses
quotes: The Guide is a weapon for the defense of the true faith against the many-headed hydra of heresy.

name: St. Edmund the Martyr
title: King of East Anglia
quotes: My soul is my own, and my faith I will never surrender.
I will not buy my life with the loss of my soul.

name: St. Edmund Rich
quotes: Jesus of Nazareth

name: St. Paulinus of Nola
quotes: The only thing we have that is really ours is our soul; let us then keep it for God.
A mind that has been dedicated to Christ is closed to the teachings of Apollo.

name: St. Peter Damian
title: The Scourge of Simony
quotes: It is impossible for the soul to be filled with God if it is first filled with the world.
Do not be discouraged; if the soul is to be saved, it must be seasoned with the salt of tribulation.
The world is so filled with the filth of impurity that the very air is infected.

name: St. Elizabeth Ann Seton
title: Foundress of the American Sisters of Charity
quotes: If I am right Thy grace impart still in the right to say. If I am wrong Oh, teach my heart to find the better way.
The first end I propose in our daily work is to do the will of God; secondly, to do it in the manner He wills it; and thirdly, to do it because it is His will.
Be children of the Church.

name: St. Elizabeth of Schönau
title: The Seer of Schönau
quotes: I am not a deceiver, but I have seen the wonders of God.
Be mindful of your path, for the Lord seeks faithful shepherds.

name: St. Germain of Paris
title: Father of the Poor
quotes: If you have not a heart of iron, you must be moved by the sight of so much misery.

name: St. Gerard Majella
title: Father of the Poor
quotes: I will do that which seems to be more perfect.
Brother Gerard is a saint.

name: St. John Nepomucene
title: Martyr of the Confessional
quotes: Only he who rules well is worthy of the name of king.

name: St. John the Baptist
title: The Precursor
quotes: Behold the Lamb of God, behold him who taketh away the sin of the world.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, make straight the way of the Lord.

name: St. John Francis Regis
title: Apostle of the Vivarais
quotes: I am as fresh as a rose.

name: St. Francis Caracciolo
quotes: Zelus domus tuae comedit me

name: St. Ouen
quotes: O God, Who didst make blessed Ouen Thy Confessor and Bishop, renowned for many miracles, grant that we who keep his festival may be helped by his prayers.

name: St. Eustathius
title: Confessor of the Nicene Faith
quotes: The apparition of Samuel was not a reality but a mere phantasm called up in the brain of Saul.

name: St. Felix of Valois
title: Co-founder of the Order of the Holy Trinity

name: St. Colman
quotes: The Easter which I keep, I received from my elders, who sent me hither as bishop.

name: St. Paul of the Cross
title: Founder of the Passionists
quotes: The Passion of Jesus is the greatest and most stupendous work of divine love.
When you are alone in your room, take your crucifix, kiss its five wounds and tell it to preach you a sermon.
The more we are like the Crucified, the more we are like the Savior.

name: St. Notburga
quotes: Let my sickle be judge between me and you.

name: St. Felix of Cantalice
title: Ass of the Capuchins
quotes: Deo Gratias!
I am the ass of the Capuchins.

name: St. Germaine Cousin
title: The Shepherdess of Pibrac
quotes: The Rosary was her only book.

name: St. Ferdinand III
title: The Liberator of Spain
quotes: I fear the curse of one poor woman more than a whole army of Saracens.

name: St. Fiacc
title: Chief Bishop of Leinster
quotes: Patrick preached the Gospel to the Scots; he suffered great toil in the islands.
He chose a place to be a help to his soul; he went into a cave in the side of a hill.

name: St. Fidelis of Sigmaringen
title: First Martyr of the Propaganda
quotes: I came to extirpate heresy, not to embrace it.

name: St. Fothad
title: of the Canon
quotes: The Church of the living God let her alone, waste her not.

name: St. Josaphat Kuncevyc
title: Apostle of Unity
quotes: Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a poor sinner.

name: St. Gertrude the Great
title: Herald of Divine Love
quotes: I have seen thee as it were a mirror, and I have seen myself in thee.
O Sacred Heart of Jesus, fountain of eternal life, Your Heart is a glowing furnace of Love.

name: St. Francis of Assisi
title: The Poverello
quotes: Hitherto I have called you my father on earth; henceforth I desire to say only 'Our Father who art in Heaven.'
I have done my part; may Christ teach you to do yours.
What a man is in the sight of God, so much he is and no more.

name: St. Anthony
title: Father of Monks
quotes: The devil is afraid of us when we pray and fast.
He who sits in solitude and is quiet has escaped from three wars: hearing, speaking, and seeing; yet against one thing shall he continually battle: that is, his own heart.

name: St. Francis of Paula
title: Founder of the Minims
quotes: Charitas.
Out of love for God, leave the things of this world.

name: St. John Bosco
title: Father and Teacher of Youth
quotes: Not with blows, but with charity and gentleness must you draw these friends to the path of virtue.
Frequent Confession, frequent Communion, daily Mass: these are the pillars which should sustain the whole edifice of education.
As far as possible avoid punishing; try to gain love before inspiring fear.

name: St. Peter Claver
title: Apostle of the Slaves
quotes: I must dedicate myself to the service of God until death, on condition that I should consider myself the slave of the slaves.

name: St. Gaudentius
quotes: The heavenly Bread is for the nourishment of our souls.

name: St. Fursey
title: Apostle of East Anglia
quotes: The saints shall go from virtue to virtue, the God of Gods will appear in Sion.

name: St. George
title: The Great Martyr
quotes: Take good care of God's churches, honour the clergy, and have pity on the poor.

name: St. Gilbert of Sempringham
title: Founder of the Gilbertine Order
quotes: I know no surer way to perdition.

name: St. Gertrude of Nivelles
quotes: I will marry neither him nor any other man, but Christ alone shall be my bridegroom.

name: St. Philip Romolo Neri
title: Apostle of Rome
quotes: Salvete, flores martyrum.
A joyful heart is more easily made perfect than a downcast one.
Well, and then?

name: St. Gildas
title: The Wise
quotes: Britain has priests, but they are unwise; very many ministers, but they are shameless; clerics, but they are treacherous.

name: St. Veronica Giuliani
title: Bride of the Crucified
quotes: Do justice, God sees you.

name: St. Gregory of Nyssa
title: The Father of Mysticism
quotes: Concepts create idols; only wonder comprehends anything.
The soul that looks up to God has always some new aspect of the Divine to look upon.
Every desire for the Beautiful that is drew us on to this, and every fear of the Terrible that is kept us from that.

name: St. Gregory of Neocaesarea
title: The Wonder Worker
quotes: There is therefore nothing created, nothing greater or less in the Trinity, nothing superadded, as though it had not existed before.
May God grant that the number of the unbelievers should be as small as the number of the faithful was when I was first made bishop.

name: St. Hedwig
title: Patroness of Silesia
quotes: Would you oppose the will of God? Our lives are in His hands, and whatever He does is well done.
Whatever I have, I have only that I may give it to the poor.

name: St. Julie Billiart
title: Foundress of the Sisters of Notre Dame
quotes: Oh, qu'il est bon, le bon Dieu!
Be like the sunflower that follows every movement of the sun, and keep your eyes always turned towards our good God.

name: St. Ultan of Ardbraccan
title: The Father of Orphans
quotes: Christus in nostra insula, que est in medio maris.

name: St. Herbert of Derwentwater
title: The Hermit of Derwentwater
quotes: Obtain for me the grace that we might both be admitted to praise God in heaven at the same time.

name: St. Henry II
title: The Pious
quotes: I will do everything for the honor of God and the progress of the Church.

name: St. Joseph Calasanctius
title: The Job of the Christian Era
quotes: The most noble, the most meritorious, and the most profitable work is the education of children, especially the poor.
My labor has for its object the glory of God and the service of my neighbor.

name: St. Polycarp
quotes: Fourscore and six years have I served Him, and he has done me no harm. How then can I curse my King that saved me.
Ay, ay, I recognise the first-born of Satan.
O good God, for what times hast thou kept me that I should endure such things?

name: St. Justin Martyr
title: The Philosopher
quotes: No one in his right mind gives up piety for impiety.
That is our desire, to be tortured for Our Lord, Jesus Christ, and so to be saved.
Our doctrine surpasses all human doctrine because the real Word became Christ.

name: St. Hilda
title: Mother of the English Church
quotes: Preserve the gospel of peace among yourselves and towards all others.

name: St. Ildephonsus
title: Chaplain of the Virgin
quotes: O most holy Lady, most pure Mother of God, I am thy servant, and the son of thy handmaid.

name: St. Isidore of Pelusium
title: The Pelusiote
quotes: The life should correspond with the words, that one should practice what one teaches.
Retirement includes forgetfulness of the things one has abandoned and the renunciation of old habits.
Great abstinences serve no purpose unless they are accompanied by the mortification of the senses.

name: St. James the Greater
title: Son of Thunder
quotes: Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?

name: St. Joseph of Leonessa
quotes: Brother Ass, there is no need to feed thee as a noble horse would be fed: thou must be content to be a poor ass.

name: St. Ivo of Chartres
title: Light of the Canonists
quotes: When the law seems to be in conflict, the rule of charity must prevail.
The keys of the Church are the power of binding and loosing.

name: St. Lazarus of Bethany
title: Friend of Christ
quotes: Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

name: St. Pionius
quotes: Refrain from mocking those Christians who have apostatized.

name: St. Rose of Lima
title: The Flower of Lima
quotes: Lord, increase my sufferings, and with them increase Thy love in my heart.

name: St. James of the Marches
title: Apostle of the Marches
